description: Load a skill's SKILL.md, or one of its linked references, templates or scripts. The first call returns SKILL.md plus a 'linked_files' dict; call again with file_path to read one. A remote MCP skill is qualified 'server::skill' in the index — load it by that name, or by passing server and uri together.
name: skill_view

file_path.description: OPTIONAL: Path to a linked file within the skill (e.g., 'references/api.md', 'templates/config.yaml', 'scripts/validate.py'). Omit to get the main SKILL.md content.

name.description: The skill name (use skills_list to see available skills). For plugin-provided skills, use the qualified form 'plugin:skill'; for a remote MCP skill, the qualified form shown in the skills index or server+uri.

server.description: OPTIONAL: Name of the MCP server publishing a remote skill. Pass together with uri; a remote skill is loaded once and its content is verified against what the server declared.

uri.description: OPTIONAL: The SKILL.md resource URI of a remote skill (e.g. 'skill://group/name/SKILL.md'). Pass together with server.
